spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
    child_ou.id as child_id,
    child_ou.name as child_name,
    build_drill_url(child_ou.id) as drill_url,
    CASE WHEN child_ou.level >= 5 THEN
      '/d/heart360_facility?var-Region=' || COALESCE((SELECT lin2.ancestor_id::text FROM org_unit_lineage lin2 WHERE lin2.org_unit_id = child_ou.id AND lin2.ancestor_level = 1), '') ||
      '&var-District=' || COALESCE((SELECT lin2.ancestor_id::text FROM org_unit_lineage lin2 WHERE lin2.org_unit_id = child_ou.id AND lin2.ancestor_level = 2), '') ||
      '&var-Facility=' || COALESCE((SELECT lin2.ancestor_id::text FROM org_unit_lineage lin2 WHERE lin2.org_unit_id = child_ou.id AND lin2.ancestor_level = 3), '') ||
      '&var-Sub_Facility=' || COALESCE((SELECT lin2.ancestor_id::text FROM org_unit_lineage lin2 WHERE lin2.org_unit_id = child_ou.id AND lin2.ancestor_level = 4), '')
    ELSE NULL END as facility_url,
    SUM(COALESCE(uc.nb_patients_under_care, 0)) AS nb_patients_under_care,
    SUM(COALESCE(nb_new_patients, 0)) AS nb_patients_newly_registered,
    SUM(cat.nb_patients_controlled) AS nb_patients_controlled,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(cat.nb_patients_controlled) / NULLIF(GREATEST(0, SUM(cat.TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_PATIENTS) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_NEWLY_REGISTERED) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_LOST_TO_FOLLOW_UP)), 0)) AS per_patients_controlled,
    SUM(cat.nb_patients_uncontrolled) AS nb_patients_uncontrolled,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(cat.nb_patients_uncontrolled) / NULLIF(GREATEST(0, SUM(cat.TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_PATIENTS) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_NEWLY_REGISTERED) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_LOST_TO_FOLLOW_UP)), 0)) AS per_patients_uncontrolled,
    SUM(cat.nb_patients_no_visit) AS nb_patients_no_visit,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(cat.nb_patients_no_visit) / NULLIF(GREATEST(0, SUM(cat.TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_PATIENTS) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_NEWLY_REGISTERED) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_LOST_TO_FOLLOW_UP)), 0)) AS per_patients_no_visit
FROM HEART360_PATIENTS_CATEGORY cat
JOIN org_unit_lineage lin ON cat.org_unit_id = lin.org_unit_id
JOIN org_units child_ou ON lin.ancestor_id = child_ou.id AND child_ou.parent_id = ((SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${test_variable_name}'), '') LIMIT 1))
LEFT JOIN heart360_patients_registered
    ON cat.ref_month = heart360_patients_registered.ref_month
    AND cat.org_unit_id = heart360_patients_registered.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN HEART360_PATIENTS_UNDER_CARE uc
    ON cat.ref_month = uc.ref_month
    AND cat.org_unit_id = uc.org_unit_id
WHERE cat.ref_month = (
    SELECT MAX(ref_month) FROM HEART360_PATIENTS_CATEGORY
    WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(((SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${test_variable_name}'), '') LIMIT 1))))
    AND $__timeFilter(ref_month)
)
GROUP BY child_ou.id, child_ou.name, child_ou.level
ORDER BY child_ou.name
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH selected_org AS (
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(((SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${test_variable_name}'), '') LIMIT 1)))
),
known_months AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', series_date)::date AS ref_month
  FROM generate_series(
    DATE_TRUNC('month', (SELECT MIN(registration_date) FROM patients)),
    DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE),
    '1 month'::interval
  ) AS t(series_date)
),
monthly_registrations AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', p.registration_date)::date AS ref_month,
    COUNT(*) AS nb_new_patients
  FROM patients p
  WHERE LOWER(p.patient_status) <> 'dead'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_diagnoses pd WHERE pd.patient_id = p.patient_id AND pd.diagnosis_code = 'I10')
    AND p.org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM selected_org)
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', p.registration_date)
),
htn_under_care AS (
  SELECT
    uc.ref_month,
    SUM(uc.nb_patients_under_care) AS nb_patients_under_care
  FROM HEART360_PATIENTS_UNDER_CARE uc
  WHERE uc.org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM selected_org)
  GROUP BY uc.ref_month
)
SELECT
  km.ref_month,
  SUM(COALESCE(mr.nb_new_patients, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY km.ref_month) AS cumulative_number_of_patients,
  c.nb_patients_under_care,
  COALESCE(mr.nb_new_patients, 0) AS nb_new_patients
FROM known_months km
LEFT JOIN monthly_registrations mr ON mr.ref_month = km.ref_month
LEFT JOIN htn_under_care c ON c.ref_month = km.ref_month
ORDER BY km.ref_month
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

spec.definition:
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(1), 0) AS is_allowed
FROM grafana_schema.user u
LEFT OUTER JOIN grafana_schema.team_member tm ON tm.user_id = u.id
LEFT OUTER JOIN grafana_schema.team t ON tm.team_id = t.id
WHERE u.id = ${__user.id}
  AND (
      u.is_admin = true
      OR t.name IN (
          SELECT (SELECT group_name FROM heart360tk_schema.get_access_groups(lin.ancestor_id, 'aggregated') LIMIT 1)
          FROM heart360tk_schema.org_unit_lineage lin
          WHERE lin.org_unit_id = NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), '')::int
          
          UNION
          
          SELECT (SELECT group_name FROM heart360tk_schema.get_access_groups(lin.ancestor_id, 'patients') LIMIT 1)
          FROM heart360tk_schema.org_unit_lineage lin
          WHERE lin.org_unit_id = NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), '')::int
      )
      OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 
          FROM heart360tk_schema.hierarchy_config hc
          WHERE t.name IN (
              'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_aggregated_ALL',
              'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_patients_ALL'
          )
            AND hc.level <= (SELECT level FROM heart360tk_schema.org_units WHERE id = NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), '')::int LIMIT 1)
      )
  )
